caption: The drawing shows seven objects with blue tops and brown bases arranged vertically and diagonally on the left half of the image. Six of these objects are similar in size and shape with smooth, flared blue tops and squared brown lower ends, while one is longer and segmented with a similarly styled blue top and brown base. To the right of these, there is an L-shaped brown and blue object: a long vertical brown stick with circular holes, attached at the top by a horizontal blue bar with black dots, and a rounded brown base at the bottom. The background is a plain beige. The objects are depicted clearly and are separated from each other with no overlapping.
